profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer Intern - ML Compiler Team
profile.summary: Hello! I'm passionate about low-level performance optimization, compilation and machine learning. I'm currently working on the Mirage ML compiler project, and am looking for internships in ML compilation/systems!

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - ML Compiler Team
Research Assistant - GPU Kernels
positions.description:
• Leveraged inter-layer shared memory pipelining within a megakernel to improve the decoding
latency of Qwen3-0.6B by 10% on Blackwell GPUs.
• Integrated the optimization into the MPK compiler and runtime, which also incorporates CUDA
superoptimization, kernel fusion and automatic scheduling to improve LLM inference.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a code generation framework for UDP protocols, achieving the goals of deduplication and validation.

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description:
• Designed convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to pinpoint tumor locations using PyTorch.
• Analyzed CT scans from the Liver Tumor Segmentation (LiTS) dataset to identify liver tumors with a Dice accuracy score of ~0.7.
• Enhanced pipeline by dynamically constructing model to adapt to dataset characteristics.
• Formulated a semi-supervised ensemble voting strategy to improve training on unlabeled data.
• Scripted a GPU load balancer to distribute jobs to non-peak hours using Bash.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Multithreading · Deep Learning · Python (Programming Language) · Creative Problem Solving · Software Development · PyTorch · Computer Vision · Data Science · Bash · Problem Solving

company.name: A*STAR - Agency for Science, Technology and Research

positions.title: Software Developer, Platoon Sergeant
positions.description:
Rank: Second Sergeant
• Developed full-stack Python application to enhance administration of medical and annual leaves of ~50 military personnel, replacing old hardcopy system.
• Integrated a Telegram bot for reporting, a Firebase backend and interactive data visualization with Dash for efficient command planning.
• Led a team to configure, set up and troubleshoot network clusters during Division planning exercises.
• Directed the Division communications store, drafted and issued loans, oversaw stock-takes, prepared laptops using Acronis.
• Supported planning and execution for multiple Unit Induction Programs to onboard new operators and specialists.
• Participated in shooting and video editing for National Day Parade 2022 as part of the Multimedia Content Team.
positions.insights: Skills: R (Programming Language) · Adobe Premiere Pro · Computer Networking · Oral Communication · Leadership · People Management · Python (Programming Language) · Communication · R Shiny · Creative Problem Solving · Software Development · Attention to Detail · Acronis · Computer Information Systems · Project Management · Problem Solving

projects.title: ClawMachineXXL
projects.description:
• Designing and prototyping a room-sized interactable claw machine using Arduino for Spring Carnival.
• Leading the Electricals team, liasing with other committees, and establishing wiring plans.

projects.title: Automajumper
projects.description:
• Led game design, programmed features and wrote for cellular automata platformer Automajumper.
• Won Most Innovative Gameplay award for combining rhythm and platformer elements.
